messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — UnityEdge sent their final marketplace bundle and a CSV for SKUs. Need a quick pass on logo badging, copy limits, and the legal attribution clause before we publish. Folder: https://drive.google.com/unityedge-assets :eyes:
Ethan Kim: thanks — can someone confirm whether we should use their stacked logo or horizontal for the marketplace tile? the hero crop is tight.
Liam (design): stacked loses the wordmark at small sizes. horizontal fits better at 580x320 but we might need to trim spacing. i uploaded two exports to the figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/UE-tiles
Priya Singh: also need translations for FR/DE for the short description. UnityEdge gave machine-translated strings, legal asked we don't ship MT for FR without review.
Jin Park: quick legal note — partner requires the following attribution in the marketplace listing footer: "UnityEdge and the UnityEdge logo are trademarks of UnityEdge Inc. Used with permission." we also need to include the attached license id: UE-LIC-2026. Do not modify the trademark language.
Maya Patel: @Jin noted. Is that compatible with marketplace character limits? the listing short desc is 200 chars.
Ethan Kim: short desc we have 198 chars with that exact line trimmed to: "UnityEdge (trademark) — used with permission. UE-LIC-2026" is that acceptable to legal?
Jin Park: hm prefer exact phrasing in footer. short desc can be trimmed. footer can hold the full phrase. we need the full phrase somewhere visible.
Liam (design): mockups updated: tile_v1_horizontal.png (primary), tile_v2_stacked.png (fallback). Also suggested badge overlay for "Verified on Redwood" — do we have approval to use Redwood badge?
Maya Patel: yes — marketing ok to use our marketplace badge. Ethan, confirm microcopy for badge: "Verified on Redwood Inference" or "Redwood Verified"?
Ethan Kim: go with "Redwood Verified" — shorter. I'll update the listing copy.
partner-assets-bot: Asset upload: unityedge_tile_assets.zip (6 files) uploaded by UnityEdge via SFTP at 2248123468
Priya Singh: translations — tagging @Ethan: please flag any strings that need professional translation. i'll coordinate vendor purchase order.
Ethan Kim: here's the SKU mapping they provided (copying CSV snippet):
```
marketplace_sku,partner_sku,tile_name
RI-MKT-UE-SM,UE-1001,UnityEdge Inference - Small
RI-MKT-UE-MD,UE-1002,UnityEdge Inference - Medium
RI-MKT-UE-ENT,UE-1003,UnityEdge Inference - Enterprise
```
Maya Patel: good. need locking on the SKU prefixes — finance wants RI-MKT-UE-ENT to match existing reserved prefixes. confirm with finance before publishing.
Jin Park: one more legal check: do not use UnityEdge customer logos or quotes in the marketplace tile without signed consent. they sent a case study but haven't attached the consent forms.
Maya Patel: noted. I'll ask UnityEdge for signed consent for the case blurbs.
Liam (design): final ask — alt text for accessibility. suggestion: "UnityEdge Inference: low-latency model serving platform. Redwood Verified badge at top-right." anyone want to tweak?
Priya Singh: add language tag sets so translators know context: [short-desc], [hero-alt], [footer-attr]. i'll add a spreadsheet column.
Ethan Kim: timeline: if we get legal + finance ok by EOD tomorrow, marketing can queue publish for next Wednesday. otherwise it slips to next sprint.
Maya Patel: i'll ping UnityEdge for consent + confirm license id placement. thanks all. :thumbsup:
